copy.tagline: 设计消融实验来评估机器学习模型各组件贡献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要量化机器学习系统中每个模块的独立作用
copy.tagline_en: Design ablation studies to isolate component contributions in ML systems
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quantify the independent contribution of each component in an ML system

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你设计消融实验：拆解机器学习系统的组件，逐一移除或替换，来测量每个组件对整体性能的贡献。它会引导你完成组件映射、基线选择、指标定义等步骤。
howto.when: 当你需要分析机器学习系统中不同组件的影响时触发。例如，你提出“我想知道我的模型哪些部分最重要”或“帮我设计一个消融实验”时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个消融实验，分析我的图像分类模型每个组件的贡献。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义组件和基线。

say.text: 我的推荐系统有三个模块，如何量化每个模块的重要性？
say.note: Claude 会建议合适的消融类型和实验次数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you design ablation studies: break down ML system components, remove or replace one at a time, and measure the impact on overall performance. It guides you through component mapping, baseline selection, metric specification, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze the contribution of different components in a machine learning system, e.g., when you ask 'Which parts of my model matter most?' or 'Design an ablation study.'

say_en.text: Design an ablation study for my image classifier to isolate each component's contribution.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through component and baseline definitions.

say_en.text: My recommender has three modules; how can I quantify each module's importance?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest ablation type and sample size.
